subject: Affiliate cohort — promo credit fulfillment and delivery plan
messages:
From: Sara Nguyen <sara@devopsacademy.io>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Promo codes for June cohort webinar

Hi Connor / Marissa —

Thanks again for the chat last week. DevOps Academy is running a paid cohort on June 14 and we'd love to offer a special sponsor perk to registrants: 100 trial credits for Redwood (redeemable for 60 days). Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide those as single-use promo codes we can distribute to attendees?

Key asks:
- 100 unique single-use codes
- Expiry: 60–90 days OK? Prefer 90 days if possible
- CSV with code + expiration + one-line instructions for recipients

I've attached the rough attendee list (cohort_partner_list.csv) to estimate distribution cadence. If pricing/terms need to be signed off, loop in whoever handles approvals.

Appreciate a quick yes/no so we can lock this into our email sequence.

Best,
Sara
Sara Nguyen
Partnerships Manager | DevOps Academy
Attachments: cohort_partner_list.csv (CSV, 2.3KB)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Nguyen <sara@devopsacademy.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Promo codes for June cohort webinar

Hi Sara —

Yes — we can do 100 unique, single-use trial promo codes. Proposal below:

Plan:
- Issue 100 single-use promo codes, each redeemable for 1000 tokens / $10 equivalent (internal unit).
- Expiry: default 90 days from issuance (we can do 60 on request).
- Distribution: we will provide a CSV with code, expiry (ISO date), and a 1-line redemption instruction.
- Delivery: final CSV and upload to your Mailchimp account (or we can provide a secure download link).

Operational notes (attached): promo_codes_template.csv and promo_codes_ops_checklist.pdf. Ben, can you:
1) generate the codes in the promo pipeline
2) run the ops checklist and mark the batch as \"DevOps Academy — June 14\"
3) prepare the CSV with the exact expiration timestamps

Sara — if you want the codes to be gated (one per registrant email), we can set email binding but that will add ~24 hours to prep. Otherwise they'll be single-use open codes.

Also: HubSpot deal HS-DA-2027-0482 will be updated with the fulfillment. Drive folder for assets: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPromoPack

If that works, Ben and Marissa will confirm timelines and we can get you the CSV by Friday EOD.

Thanks,
Connor
Head of Partnerships (act.) | Redwood Inference
Attachments: promo_codes_template.csv (CSV, 1.1KB), promo_codes_ops_checklist.pdf (PDF, 48KB)

From: Sara Nguyen <sara@devopsacademy.io>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir@devopsacademy.io>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Promo codes for June cohort webinar

Connor —

This is great, thanks. Two quick clarifications: 1) Can the expiry be 90 days (that's our preference), and 2) we prefer open single-use codes (not locked to emails) — simplifies our automated flow.

Also can you confirm whether these codes can be set to throttle (one redemption per IP per hour) to prevent abuse, or do you have other fraud controls?

If everything checks, we'll plan to include the code instructions in our confirmation emails and ask registrants to redeem within 14 days of cohort kickoff.

I'll wait for your CSV and ops sign-off.

Thanks,
Sara

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Promo codes for June cohort webinar — approval to proceed

Thanks for the context Connor. Approving production of the 100 single-use open promo codes with 90-day expiry. Ben — please complete the ops checklist and hand the CSV to Sara via the Drive link (or upload to the Mailchimp list she provided).

Deliverables and timeline:
- Ben: generate codes and mark in HubSpot by EOD Friday (2027-05-28)
- Ben: run the promo_codes_ops_checklist.pdf and attach the results to the HubSpot deal
- Send final_codes_20270526.csv to Sara and copy Connor/Marissa when delivered

Fraud controls: Ben, please enable redemption heuristics (one-use tokens, device/IP throttling, and a daily redemption cap) per the ops checklist. If any of those settings will block legitimate users, flag and escalate.

Sara — once Ben completes, Connor or I will confirm the CSV location. Thanks — excited to support the cohort.

Marissa Cole
Director, Growth | Redwood Inference
Attachments: final_codes_20270526.csv (CSV, 2.5KB)
